exposure: presence of a medical doctor at primary healthcare (PHC) clinics
outcome: proportion of doctor consultations warranting management by a doctor due to complexity
spectrum of medical conditions managed by clinic doctors
cohort: The study involved 7,424 patient consultations conducted by 35 doctors in 45 PHC clinics in uMgungundlovu District, KwaZulu-Natal.
finding: The research demonstrated that 93.6% of doctor consultations at PHC clinics were of sufficient complexity to warrant management by a medical doctor, supporting the benefit of doctors in these settings.
